grid.note: Values are sampled from the existing ~100 m query grid, not native 10 m measurements.

elevation.method: rounded to integer metres from the existing shared-grid display raster
elevation.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (2021 release; DSM, EGM2008 heights)

provenance.source: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public (2021 release; DSM, EGM2008 heights)
provenance.method: Mosaicked Copernicus N11 E075 and N11 E076 COGs; bilinear warp to EPSG:3857 ~100 m display grid; fixed non-negative elevation bins; district mask; exact RGBA PNG
provenance.displayValues: ~100 m query grid; not native 10 m data

slope.method: rounded to 0.01 degree from the existing shared-grid display raster
slope.source: Derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public
slope.resolution: ~30 m original DEM; 90 m metric analysis; ~100 m display

provenance.source: Derived from Copernicus DEM GLO-30 Public
provenance.resolution: ~30 m original DEM; 90 m metric analysis; ~100 m display
provenance.method: DEM bilinear warp to EPSG:32643 at 90 m; finite-difference slope in metres; categorical result nearest-warped to EPSG:3857 ~100 m display grid; district mask; exact RGBA PNG
provenance.displayValues: ~100 m query grid; not native 10 m data

landcover.method: copied class code from the existing shared-grid display raster

provenance.method: Nearest warp from WorldCover categorical COG to EPSG:3857 ~100 m display grid; district mask; noData transparent; class 95 explicitly mapped to Mangroves; exact RGBA PNG
provenance.displayValues: ~100 m query grid; not native 10 m data

landslide.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI), via KSDMA
landslide.period: GSI/Bhukosh April 2022 source snapshot; KSDMA derivative processed 12–15 August 2025 (not a 2025 survey)
landslide.resolution: 1:50,000 GSI NLSM programme scale (official policy); supplied district derivative does not declare original raster cell size or positional accuracy. ~100 m atlas query cells are display sampling, not accuracy.
landslide.method: Native UTM43N polygon repair and district clip; pixel-centre categorical rasterization on shared query grid.
landslide.sourceScale: 1:50,000 NLSM regional programme; see scale evidence in provenance
landslide.accuracy: No district-specific independent accuracy estimate established.
landslide.rights: GSI web-display and redistribution rights remain unresolved. Source attribution, this caveat and owner approval do not grant permission. Public download is not an open reuse licence; GSI source rights are retained. No written permission is claimed; GSI map exports remain withheld.
landslide.attribution: Geological Survey of India, 2022 / Kerala State Disaster Management Authority. Atlas display adaptation, not an official warning product.
